name: delegate_task
description: Wren's first-class DELEGATION action (R01, gate-respecting). Hands a real council task to a specific worker with a named VERIFIER, notifies them over the leadership relay, and logs the whole handoff so she can follow it up. Picks the right worker by REAL signals: an explicit assignee wins (tp / asa / bill), otherwise it auto-selects the least-loaded eligible worker CEO, preferring one that is online now (relay heartbeat); the verifier is always a DIFFERENT signoff-CEO so no one verifies their own work. It is WIP-CAP RESPECTING: before landing an assignment it runs the council's own cap_check (GATE 17 per-CEO cap + the global WIP ceiling). If there is capacity the task is truly assigned (state=assigned, assignee set) and the worker is pinged; if the council is saturated it does NOT force work onto a jammed board — it records a PENDING (earmarked) delegation citing the real gate, which governor_act promotes when a slot frees. Params: title (or an existing task_id), description, assignee, verifier, priority, reason (why this worker), notify (relay DM, default true). Writes an append-only ledger row to data/registries/qsb_wren_delegations.jsonl and a governor_delegation audit row to F47. Never flips a gate, never bypasses the cap.

task_id.description: delegate an EXISTING open board task instead of creating one

assignee.description: omit to auto-pick least-loaded online worker

verifier.description: omit to auto-pick a different signoff-CEO

reason.description: why this worker gets it (surfaced to them)
